qualification.details: Project Associate I: B.E/ B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Electrical and Electronics Engineering/ Biomedical Engineering or allied areas. Project Associate II: B.E/ B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Computer Science & Engineering/ Electrical and Electronics Engineering/ Biomedical Engineering or allied areas with 2 years experience in Research and Development or M.E/ M.Tech./ M.S in Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Biomedical Engineering/ Digital Signal Processing/ Signal Processing or allied areas with minimum of 1st class in B.E/ B.Tech & M.E/ M.Tech. Junior Research Fellow: M.E/ M.Tech./ M.S in Electronics and Communication Engineering/ Biomedical Engineering/ Digital Signal Processing/ Signal Processing or allied areas with minimum of 1st class in B.E/ B.Tech & M.E/ M.Tech and GATE/ CSIR-JRF/ NET-JRF qualification. Research Associate I: Ph.D in Microelectronics & VLSI Design or Signal Processing or M.E/ M.Tech having 3 years of research experience with at least one research paper in SCI/ SCIE Journal (Specialized in Design and Development of Instrumentation Amplifier for EEG Signal Acquisition or FPGA implementation of EEG Signal Processing, Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms). Research Associate II: Ph.D in Microelectronics & VLSI Design or Signal Processing or M.E/ M.Tech having 3 years of research experience with at least one research paper in SCI/ SCIE Journal. Research Associate III: Ph.D in Microelectronics & VLSI Design or Signal Processing or M.E/ M.Tech having 3 years of research experience with at least one research paper in SCI/ SCIE Journal.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by NIT Uttarakhand?
faq.answer: NIT Uttarakhand has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Project Associate / JRF / Research Associate.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications range from B.E/B.Tech to Ph.D. in relevant engineering and science disciplines as specified in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the candidates applying for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate / JRF / Research Associate positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 67,000/- per month, plus HRA as per norms, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the NIT Uttarakhand recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the NIT Uttarakhand located?
faq.answer: NIT Uttarakhand is located in Srinagar Garhwal, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 246174.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and more details?
faq.answer: The official notification and further details can be found on the official website of NIT Uttarakhand, and a direct link is provided in the Important Links section.
